text: I'm ready, God, so ready, ready from head to toe. Ready to sing, ready to raise a God-song:
singing your praises in town and country.
every cloud's a flag to your faithfulness.
Cover the whole earth with your glory!
reach down and help me—answer me!
"Brimming over with joy, I make a present of Shechem, I hand out Succoth Valley as a gift.
to say nothing of Manasseh. Ephraim's my hard hat, Judah my hammer.
I mop the floor with Moab, Spit on Edom, rain fireworks all over Philistia."
Who'll show me the road to Edom?
refusing to go out with our troops?
he'll flatten the opposition for good.
